principle: Extracurriculars are persistent organized Academy-life entities with finite membership and recurring time commitments. Membership is voluntary context, not an automatic relationship, skill or reward.
rules: Extracurricular identity and roster exist independently of player observation.
Membership is anchored to population_slot_ref and may exist before full NPC materialization.
Existing valid memberships are preserved before allocating new roster slots.
NPCs may autonomously apply/join using explicit interests, hobbies and preference state as affinity inputs.
Species, gender, culture, player proximity and desired story chemistry are not generic enrollment weights.
The player receives eligible options but is never automatically enrolled.
Player and NPC membership obey the same eligibility, prerequisite, capacity, facility and schedule constraints.
Recurring sessions consume real time and must fit the cadet timetable including travel.
A full roster remains full; the system may not synthesize a vacancy for the player.
An activity requiring unavailable facilities cannot accept a member for an impossible recurring schedule.
Membership may be active while an individual session is missed; attendance is separate runtime/event truth.
Membership alone creates no friendship, rivalry, romance, attraction, mentorship or relationship mutation.
Membership alone creates no competence, qualification, academic grade, reputation or wellbeing benefit.
Confirmed actual participation may later become evidence for other systems, but Step 7 does not apply those effects.
Withdrawal, removal or activity closure requires an explicit membership/activity event and preserves history.
Formal seminars, conferences and additional academic courses are excluded and belong to Step 8.
